t: A small desktop robot from Luxonis built on OAK vision for edge AI projects.
steps: Look for the rae on the Luxonis site and check whether it is in stock.
Ask Luxonis for the current setup guide and docs.
Ask what computers and accounts the robot needs.
Ask IT to review the answers.
Power the robot as the guide directs.
Run a first vision demo from the docs.
Plan a small student project after the demo works.
